<description>
Split from #36808.

This PR fixes IWYU warnings in the following source files and their associated headers, and add them to `IWYU_SRC_FILES`, so that any new warnings there fail CI:
- `chain.cpp`
- `headerssync.cpp`
- `key_io.cpp`
- `merkleblock.cpp`
- `pow.cpp`

The changes in other files add includes of headers that were previously included transitively.
</description>
